cases.name: cliente_existente_con_prestamos
cases.selector_sql: SELECT l.customer_id FROM public.loans AS l WHERE l.customer_id > 0 GROUP BY l.customer_id ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l.status) DESC, COUNT(*) DESC, l.customer_id LIMIT 1
cases.expected_sql: SELECT json_build_object('customer_id', c.id, 'total_loans', COUNT(l.id), 'active_loans', COUNT(l.id) FILTER (WHERE l.status = 'active'), 'defaulted_loans', COUNT(l.id) FILTER (WHERE l.status = 'defaulted'), 'paid_off_loans', COUNT(l.id) FILTER (WHERE l.status = 'paid_off')) FROM (SELECT CAST(%s AS integer) AS id) AS c LEFT JOIN public.loans AS l ON l.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id

cases.name: cliente_existente_sin_prestamos
cases.selector_sql: SELECT c.id FROM public.customers AS c WHERE c.id > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.loans AS l WHERE l.customer_id = c.id) ORDER BY c.id LIMIT 1

cases.name: cliente_inexistente
cases.selector_sql: SELECT candidatos.id FROM (SELECT 1 AS id UNION ALL SELECT c.id + 1 FROM public.customers AS c WHERE c.id >= 1 AND c.id < 2147483647) AS candidatos WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.customers AS c WHERE c.id = candidatos.id) ORDER BY candidatos.id LIMIT 1
